Call Bliss silences unwanted callers, while ensuring you never miss important calls, making Do Not Disturb easier to use and more powerful. Allow or silence callers and groups of callers with a single tap, or automatically by location,  Home, Work, or anywhere else.

At the office? Allow co-workers and your boss to ring your phone. At home? Ignored!  Create groups of callers such as Friends, Family, Co-Workers, Bowling Team, and allow or silence all of them with one tap.

Includes special modes. Put unwanted callers in the "ExcludeList", while ensuring other contacts can always reach you.  Need to focus on a project?  "Suppress All Callers" mode sends all calls to voicemail until your project is done.
